fusions.name: Barnyard Jostle
fusions.desc: A warm shoulder-barge that deals 4 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles and restores 2 health to you.

fusions.name: Settling Weight
fusions.desc: A slow, crushing lean that deals 28 damage and, against a boss or an elite, 6% of their maximum health. It leaves the target [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Huddle Close
fusions.desc: Restores 14 health to you and every ally within 3.5 tiles, and more the faster you cast.

fusions.name: Winter Barn
fusions.desc: Your maximum health rises by 12. You also regenerate 1 health a second, permanently.
